name: Rogo
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Rogo is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Rogo is a privately held artificial intelligence company serving the financial industry. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent funding round, a $160 million Series D announced on April 29, 2026, was reported to value the company at $2 billion.

Based in New York, Rogo provides an AI platform that investment banks, asset managers and private equity firms use for research, financial modeling and the preparation of client presentations. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Rogo has not disclosed its valuations; the figures shown are as reported by Bloomberg and Axios at the time of each round.
round_notes: In September 2026, Rogo announced strategic investments from Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners and Société Générale, without disclosing the amount. On November 18, 2026, Bloomberg reported that Rogo was raising new capital at a valuation of $3.75 billion. Rogo has not announced that round.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Kleiner Perkins led the Series D, with participation from Thrive Capital, Sequoia Capital, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners and Khosla Ventures. Sequoia Capital led the Series C, Thrive Capital the Series B, Khosla Ventures the Series A and AlleyCorp the seed round. Other investors include Tiger Global, Wells Fargo, Henry Kravis and BoxGroup.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show two special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Rogo, organized in 2024 and 2026.
sources: Sources: Rogo's announcements of its Series D, Series C, Series B, Series A and seed round, and of its strategic investors (September 10, 2026); reports by Bloomberg (October 2025, April 2026 and November 2026) and Axios (January 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
